rebuttals.argument: The ruling accurately reflects our continued commitment to incremental morning labor and our geo-targeted $1 Order Ahead app offer for new and lapsed users. The implementation of a local review process to monitor lane times, Order Ahead volume, and repeat visits is a natural progression to ensure the effectiveness and sustainability of our efforts to convert diverted Starbucks customers into loyal Dutch Bros fans. These actions are consistent with our strategy to turn frustrated morning demand into repeat visits while protecting our service proposition, and they remain within our allocated budget and operational capabilities.
